//: OpenRouter free-tier configuration. Tiers follow docs/LESSONS.md: the strongest model does the actual translation, reliable tool-callers do everything else. All are :free models with function calling (mandatory — every agent drives file tools) that keep reasoning in a separate field (no leak into output, satisfying LESSONS.md #4). This harness reaches OpenRouter through its OpenAI-compatible endpoint; the key is read from OPENROUTER_API_KEY (apiKeyEnv). Get a key at https://openrouter.ai/keys.
//model-choice: These NVIDIA/gpt-oss models are served on their own infrastructure and were the reliably-available, tool-capable free models when this was written. Popular free models routed to shared upstreams (e.g. Venice-hosted qwen/llama) are frequently HTTP-429 'rate-limited upstream' and can be unusable for a sustained pipeline. If these get saturated too, the harness retries with Retry-After backoff (see src/diagnostics.ts); check https://openrouter.ai/models for what's live and swap freely.
//limits: OpenRouter free (:free) models are shared upstream capacity: expect frequent HTTP 429 ('temporarily rate-limited upstream'), which the harness auto-retries with backoff. On top of that there is an ACCOUNT-WIDE daily cap across all free models: 50 requests/day by default, 1000/day after buying ~$10 of credits, plus ~20 req/min. A full ~100k-word novel runs on the order of ~1000 requests, so: 50 RPD = a chapter/day, a whole book over a couple of weeks (fine if unhurried — the git-checkpointed workspace resumes across days); 1000 RPD = a book in a day or two but you'll still hit upstream 429s and wait through backoff. For a smooth run, add a little OpenRouter credit or your own upstream key (BYOK, https://openrouter.ai/settings/integrations), or use the commented Anthropic paid block (no daily cap, a few dollars per book).

agent_overrides.//: Per-agent experiments — keys here override the agent's tier spec. For higher translation quality when it's available, try "translation" tier model nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free (550B, 1M ctx). Qwen is the multilingual king (qwen/qwen3-next-80b-a3b-instruct:free) but is usually Venice-hosted and 429-saturated.

pricing.//: $/MTok fallback for cost display. The :free models above cost $0 and match nothing here, so cost shows $0. These entries apply if you swap in paid models.
